texts.label: R73, ff. 89r-90r, 8 Aug 1580
texts.summary: Como to Dandini, cipher enclosure of his letter of 8 August 1580. f. 89r concerns a princely marriage negotiation; f. 90r the nun affair: the Pope does not want Dandini to speak with the Queen Mother about it, lest it give cover for some disturbance contrary to his mind, and the reproof should be moved by the Pope with the King, proceeding so circumspectly that no rumour or disorder arises. Decryption is George Lasry's (DECODE D3191, 2020, on KaJo's 2017 transcription D1789).

reading_review.note: v4 check 23 Oct 2026: the entry pointed at Lasry's group-by-group decryption file, which the scorer could not parse. A reading was written from it (texts/R73_reading.md; letter stream by research/reading_audit/v4_dandini_stream.py), f. 90r following the contemporary clear copy on f. 91 (DECODE D1137, transcribed from the image) where Lasry's values slip (144^/824^ against the copy's N.S./V.S., 'parlio' for darle). v2_score: plain 0.692, explicit holes 0.769, hole rate 0.088, 274 words. f. 90r reads as clean sentences; f. 89r (no copy, 32 illegible groups, five open codes) holds in outline (the marriage, 'fanno talvolta li servitori amorevoli de lor patroni', 'si moverebe ad abraciar la pratica') with about one hole in four words. Keeps read, grade B.
